pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Composer is the dependency manager for PHP. It resolves the libraries a project declares in composer.json, installs them into vendor/, records exact versions in composer.lock and generates an autoloader. Packages come from Packagist by default, or from VCS, path and private repositories.
Installed from the upstream release phar, which bundles all of its own dependencies. The in-place "composer self-update" command does not apply to this install; updates come through Portage.
